heavy:
Use case: stylized-concept. Design ONE production attack VFX animation sprite sheet matching this approved COLORED Chinese watercolor ink martial force: warm golden ochre, warm ivory highlights, restrained vermillion ribbon and dry-brush edges, inspired by Tale of Immortal / 鬼谷八荒. Reference is palette and brush style ONLY; make a DISTINCT HEAVY STRIKE, not another ordinary palm. Effect drives LEFT TO RIGHT. A tightly condensed wedge-shaped burst of gold/cinnabar qi with a blunt impactful leading pressure front, strong thick overlapping brush strokes and a compact bright contact starburst at the front peak. No literal hand shape needed, no weapon, no realistic fire. A heavy decisive blow, thicker/denser than basic fist/palm, short range, no giant long-distance beam. Directional left trailing strokes, clearly readable motion.
STRICT sprite atlas:4 columns x2 rows,8 equal square cells, canvas2:1 landscape, every effect fully isolated and at most60% cell width/height, generous 20% transparent padding. Genuine RGBA alpha, no white/cream halo or cloud around strokes, no background, labels/grid or border. Animated frames read left-right top-bottom: 1 compressed dark gold energy with tiny sharp white core;2 expanding driving wedge;3 dense heavy force forward;4 peak blunt strike and sharp sparse front sparks;5 force breaks into broad ink strips;6 fragmented gold/cinnabar streaks;7 few tapering wisps;8 nearly empty. Same pivot and right-facing direction across frames. Keep reference's colored ink texture, not monochrome. Transparent negative space between strokes; glow only narrow stroke edges. No circle/shield/fan/geometric arc. Game-ready VFX atlas only.
guard:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a DEFENSIVE PARRY game VFX atlas matching the reference's warm golden ochre / ivory / restrained vermillion colored Chinese watercolor ink dry-brush style. Genuine transparent alpha. NOT monochrome. No character, hands, weapons, text or background.
Effect: a SHORT UPRIGHT curved BRUSHSTROKE of qi catching an incoming blow from the RIGHT. A narrow curved right-facing parry pressure edge, top and bottom taper in broken bristles, two trailing fluid ink ribbons to the left. Localized in front of the torso, NOT a complete circular shield, dome, oval cloud, geometric smooth semicircle, magic seal or large wall. Curvature should feel hand painted and irregular. Delicate layered ochre pigment, warm ivory narrow highlights, small cinnabar inner accents. Clear clean silhouette, negative transparent space, no glow halo outside brushstroke. Rightmost part is facing incoming blow.
STRICT4 columns x2 rows,8 chronological equal square tiles, overall2:1 landscape. Every effect max55% tile width and65%tile height, fully inside tile with at least17% transparent padding; no adjacent effects touching. Frames1 visible slender gathering brush edge;2 edge rises;3 firm parry stroke;4 strongest accented pressure edge;5 tiny bright contact flash and a few angular golden ink chips at right center;6 brush edge breaks into short strokes;7 small fading fragments;8 nearly empty. Uniform origin and scale across frames. Single compact effect each cell. Actual game-ready colored ink VFX atlas, no white/gray/checkerboard background or labels. Must look like brief parrying force, not a weapon slash.
